title: Phase 2 Second Review & v10.0 Protocol Re-Audit — Public Marketing, Secondary Pages & Funnels (Re-evaluating DIR-003, DIR-005, DIR-006)
spec:
# DIR-031: Phase 2 Second Review & v10.0 Protocol Re-Audit — Public Marketing, Secondary Pages & Funnels

## 1. Executive Context & Objectives
Public marketing surfaces and onboarding funnels drive candidate and recruiter acquisition. This directive governs the comprehensive Second Review and v10.0 hardening of DIR-003 (Public Secondary Pages), DIR-005 (Semantic Marketing & Legacy Purge), and DIR-006 (Unified End-to-End User Funnel).

The audit verifies that legacy dashboard routes (/dashboard2, deprecated mock pages) are permanently eradicated, marketing funnels convert smoothly to registration, and all legal and informational pages meet executive visual standards.

## 2. Re-Audit Scope & Architectural Verification
1. **Legacy Route & Component Purge (DIR-005 Re-Audit)**:
   - Audit routing table to confirm complete removal of /dashboard2, /candidate/old, /test-routes.
   - Verify clean 301 redirects or 404 boundaries for deprecated URLs.
   - Inspect bundle to ensure no dead legacy components are included in production chunks.

2. **Conversion Funnels & Auth Flow (DIR-006 Re-Audit)**:
   - Test end-to-end candidate registration: Sign Up > Role Selection > Onboarding Wizard > First Resume Creation.
   - Test recruiter onboarding: Sign Up > Company Setup > Job Posting Creation > Candidate Search.
   - Verify Google OAuth, Firebase Auth, and email/password authentication flows.
   - Test checkout funnels from pricing table to payment completion.

3. **Public Secondary Pages (DIR-003 Re-Audit)**:
   - Verify About, Pricing, Features, FAQ, Contact, Privacy, Terms for layout integrity.
   - Confirm pricing currency toggle (INR / USD) and GST calculations.

## 3. Acceptance Criteria
1. Complete removal of all legacy dashboard routes confirmed; zero dead routes in production build.
2. Candidate onboarding funnel converts smoothly from registration to resume builder in < 3 steps.
3. Recruiter onboarding enables immediate job posting creation without broken links or errors.
4. All marketing pages achieve Lighthouse Performance >= 90 and Accessibility >= 95.
5. Pricing and checkout funnels accurately compute totals, taxes, and redirect to payment gateways.
6. Zero broken links or missing images across all public marketing routes.

## 4. Strict Invariants
1. Do not break existing user registration records or OAuth redirect callbacks.
2. Maintain valid sitemap.xml and robots.txt entries for all public pages.
3. Form submissions must validate inputs client-side and server-side with CSRF defense.
4. All marketing pages must support WCAG 2.1 AA contrast and screen-reader accessibility.
invariants: Preserve OAuth redirect URIs and authentication provider configurations
All public routes must maintain SEO meta tags and valid sitemap links
Zero dead legacy routes or unresolved bundle imports
Strict input sanitization on all public contact and lead forms
acceptanceCriteria: All legacy routes permanently redirected or purged with zero bundle bloat
End-to-end candidate and recruiter onboarding funnels verified working
Public secondary pages meet Cuba M3 executive aesthetic standards
Lighthouse Performance >= 90 and Accessibility >= 95 on landing pages
Payment checkout transitions smoothly to payment gateway
